_about: Gear: weapon ranks, what each class can carry, rarities, item names, the bonuses items can roll, legendary items and armor sets. From the old game's WPN, AFX, SETS, UNQ, RANKS and RREQ tables and its gear code.

uniques.name: Bloodcrescent
uniques.lore: A dragon's claw, ground into a blade. It grows hungrier with every swing.

uniques.name: Voidreaver
uniques.lore: Each swing drinks from the dark between stars.

uniques.name: Frostspire
uniques.lore: Its tip was cut from a glacier that never melts.

uniques.name: Dragonbone Lance
uniques.lore: Carved from the spine of the first dragon. The ruby still beats.

uniques.name: Silverwing
uniques.lore: Strung with an angel's hair; its arrows never tire.

uniques.name: Cinderhowl
uniques.lore: Molten iron runs in its cracks. It is never cool enough to holster.

uniques.name: Nightfang
uniques.lore: It bites twice, and the second bite is poison.

uniques.name: Umbral Scepter
uniques.lore: Two shadows hold its orb, and every spell is cast twice in their whispers.

uniques.name: Staff of Eternity
uniques.lore: Time bends gently around its bearer.

uniques.name: Hexflame Crook
uniques.lore: A green fire that burns curses into whatever it touches.

uniques.name: Heart of the Stair
uniques.lore: Pulses once for every floor you climb.

uniques.name: Phoenix Feather
uniques.lore: Warm to the touch, even in the crypts.
